date_note: Aaj Tak's report of 24 November gives no earlier arrest date.
exec: Surat police report arresting five suspects over a fake trading app fraud run from a call centre in Indore.
plain: Surat police say they arrested five people after raiding a call centre in Indore. Police say the gang got victims to install a fake trading app called Wealth Trade that showed false profits.

sources.name: Aaj Tak: fake Wealth Trade app fraud, Surat police bust Indore call centre

summary: Surat Cyber Crime Cell police said they arrested five suspects after raiding a call centre in Indore. According to the police account reported by Aaj Tak, the gang had victims open accounts on a real trading app, then install a fake app called Wealth Trade through an APK link, which showed profits and encouraged larger deposits. The probe began with a complaint from a Surat man.
title: Surat police say five arrested over fake Wealth Trade app fraud run from Indore call centre

validation.note: Aaj Tak only, relaying Surat police (DCP Bishakha Jain); no police release read.
